entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I need to... well, I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309. It's for the cycling shoes I bought. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this is the first time I've ever had a problem.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF8675309 now... I see the purchase of the Pro-Lace cycling shoes, delivered about 50 days ago. Can you tell me what the issue is?

They just don't work for me. I've tried them on three different rides, and I just get the most awful blisters on my heels. I thought maybe adjusting the cleats would help the fit, but it didn't. I just can't wear them.
I understand, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I just... I really needed this money back. It was a big purchase for me, and now I can't even use them. I was hoping you could just process a refund.

Alright, I've checked for you. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. Since it's been about 50 days, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Charlie.

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the cycling shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
